messages:
maria: quick RFC follow-up — proposing a per-tenant config flag `compat_v2_headers` to gate the new negotiation headers (X-Redwood-Negotiate). idea is gradual opt-in + proxy fallback. thoughts?

sam: +1 to per-tenant. need clarity on default: opt-in vs opt-out?

maria: default = OFF. we flip on per-tenant explicitly for canary customers. global opt-in only after telemetry looks good.

jon: question: how does proxy fallback work when header absent? do we synthesize old behavior server-side?

maria: plan: proxy will sniff client SDK version and, if flag off, translate new header -> legacy handshake shape. if flag on, proxy passes header through unchanged. server adds a compatibility circuit-breaker.

priya: operational concerns: we need metrics per-tenant: percent requests using new header, error spikes, p50/p95 latency, and one signal for model-fallbacks. add a migration tag in traces.

sam: agree. also add a metric for 'translated_by_proxy' so we can see how often we need to rewrite.

jon: fallback behavior needs SLA clarification: if translation fails, do we 400 or fallback to older codepath?

maria: prefer graceful fallback to old codepath + increment alert counter. only fail hard for invalid auth shapes.

priya: rollout plan sketch: stage 1 (internal tenants only) 1 week. stage 2 (10% of canary customers) 2 weeks. stage 3 (50% of opt-in tenants) 2 weeks. stage 4 global opt-in. We'll have automatic rollback if error rate > 1% or latency > baseline + 25%.

sam: how do SDKs opt-in? via env var? prefer server-side tenant flag so we don't rely on clients shipping updates immediately.

maria: SDKs can opt-in early by sending `X-Redwood-Negotiate: v2` header. but we control via tenant flag in control plane so SDKs won't lose traffic if they send header and tenant is off — proxy will rewrite.

jon: config snippet suggestion for tenant API (pseudo-JSON):
```
{
  "compat_flags": {
    "negotiation_headers": "off|on|force"
  }
}
```
force = accept header or fail fast (for testing).

priya: we should add a TTL for flags and an audit log entry whenever a tenant flag changes. compliance wants an audit trail.

ops-bot: deploy queued: stage/compat-flag-proxy-v1 -> began rollout to staging at 2026-06-15T13:04:22Z :rocket:

maria: thanks — next steps: Sam/Jon implement proxy rewrite + metric, Priya add dashboards/alerts, I'll update RFC with rollout timeline and flag semantics. ping me if you want to be in the initial canary list.

sam: I'll PR proxy code by EOD tomorrow.

jon: I'll add circuit-breaker + test harness (simulate mixed headers).

priya: dashboard PR in flight, will add runbook with rollback thresholds.

maria: perfect. saving notes here so ops/sales can reference when they ask about tenant migrations. :memo:
